normalization.nmse: MSE / frozen target-specific training variance in G0 coordinates
normalization.native: G0 value multiplied by frozen training position input scale
normalization.rms_gain: predicted uncentered RMS / target uncentered RMS
normalization.local_rms_nrmse: RMS of 0.25-s RMS-envelope error / RMS of target RMS envelope
normalization.derivative_nrmse: RMS error of complete 2-s polynomial coefficient / target coefficient RMS
normalization.band_energy: Hann-windowed complete 2-s patches, then mean energy across complete patches
normalization.peak_timing: absolute difference of first global extremum on a complete 30-s Hb window
